description: This file defines the CurrentVersionAPI class, a REST API controller for handling version information in the OrangeHRM installation upgrade process. It provides methods to get the current version and to set/update it.

classes.name: CurrentVersionAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller for retrieving and updating the current version of the application during installation or upgrade.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the current version information, either from the state container or from the database.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to set or update the current version in the state container.
